description: This Dart file defines a RealtimeService class that manages real-time communication via WebSocket with fallback to Server-Sent Events (SSE). It includes connection handling, message parsing, subscription management, auto-reconnection with exponential backoff, JWT authorization, and topic filtering.

classes.name: _Backoff
classes.description: Helper class implementing exponential backoff with jitter for reconnection attempts.

classes.name: RealtimeService
classes.description: Main class providing real-time WebSocket and SSE connectivity with subscription and reconnection logic.

methods.name: RealtimeService.withTokenGetter
methods.description: Factory method to create a RealtimeService with an external token provider.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection, attempting WebSocket first, with fallback to SSE upon failure.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes to a specific topic or channel.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes from a specific topic or channel.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the current connection and cancels reconnection attempts.
